description: Reconstruction of the Snyder-Hakim (2022) Section 4 testbed; not a replication of their figures.

equivalent_ensemble_size.note: N_eq such that the basis at N_eq matches canonical at N (ensemble-mean update)

estimated_basis.note: one pilot sample per Np, independent of the analysis ensembles; P_hat = GC o S_pilot + ridge I (GC half-width in domain units, support twice that); est_canonical, est_zca, est_F_opt are the canonical, symmetric and F-descended whitening transforms of P_hat; analysis ensembles simulated in physical space; risks normalised by the true KF MSE
